name: Spiritual Weapon

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Bonus Action creates spectral weapon; initial and later Bonus Action melee spell attacks within 5 feet of weapon; move up to 20 feet before attack; Force 1d8+ability, +1d8 per slot; Concentration.

rules.text: You create a floating, spectral force that resembles a weapon of your choice and lasts for the duration.
The force appears within range in a space of your choice, and you can immediately make one melee spell attack against one creature within 5 feet of the force.
On a hit, the target takes Force damage equal to 1d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.
As a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can move the force up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.
The damage increases by 1d8 for every slot level above 2.
